method: Compared every upload with all 15 existing invitation photos using normalized 64x64 RGB RMSE, then visually reviewed both contact sheets. Repeated captures were skipped; distinct poses and individual portraits were retained. Included photos were auto-oriented, resized to a maximum 1920px edge, and encoded as WebP quality 85 without metadata.
